title: LINC: A Neurosymbolic Approach for Logical Reasoning by Combining Language Models with First-Order Logic Provers
method: Few-shot NL→FOL, prover labels, ten-sample majority vote.
verification_guarantee: Prover derivation is relative to generated formulas.
not_guaranteed: Source fidelity
Implicit typing and predicate decomposition
Translation error independence across samples

evaluation.caveat: FOLIO removes 22 problematic examples from the historical 204; not directly comparable to other FOLIO versions.
evaluation.aggregation: Figure 3: mean accuracy from bootstrapped 10-way majority votes for LINC and comparators, including CoT.

transfer_to_repo: Useful solver baseline and explicit unknown; macro predicates and missing types resemble component loss in case 522.

title: Logic-LM: Empowering Large Language Models with Symbolic Solvers for Faithful Logical Reasoning
representation: Task-specific logic programming, FOL, CSP, SMT
method: Sentence/formula alignment, solver execution, error-message self-refinement, CoT fallback.
verification_guarantee: Execution and solver checks conditional on representation.
not_guaranteed: Executable formulas can invert direction or scope
Refinement is not guaranteed semantically monotone

evaluation.endpoint: Final answer accuracy; execution rate and conditional execution accuracy

transfer_to_repo: CNF compilation can follow semantic parsing; syntax repair alone does not fix case 74 polarity or case 119 false hard confirmation.

title: FOLIO: Natural Language Reasoning with First-Order Logic
primary_type: EMNLP peer-reviewed dataset paper; initial arXiv 2022
representation: Human-authored parallel NL/FOL stories and conclusions
method: Expert annotation and formal label verification; distinct translation and inference tasks.
verification_guarantee: Checks formal labels against supplied reference formulas.
not_guaranteed: Conclusion accuracy is not full translation equivalence
Reference data can require corrections

evaluation.endpoint: Whole-story syntax and conclusion accuracy, not slot-level source fidelity

transfer_to_repo: Reference-source inventory and independently annotated formulas are needed; gold rank cannot substitute for extraction fidelity.
code_status: Data repository inspected; version drift noted

title: Harnessing the Power of Large Language Models for Natural Language to First-Order Logic Translation
method: LLM-generated data with filtering and human sample review; LoRA translation/correction and reward-based correction.
verification_guarantee: Parser checks syntax; released LE score checks literal Boolean agreement under soft matching.
not_guaranteed: LE is not quantified FOL equivalence
Human review of a sample does not certify all synthetic pairs
Soft symbol matching may hide wrong predicates

evaluation.endpoint: BLEU and LE; human data-quality sample
evaluation.metric_audit: Static reading: metrics.py uses soft_binding=True, greedy_match=True; VecRuleEvaluator.from_nltk_tree at S visits only root[-1], dropping quantifier prefix from Boolean evaluation. No dynamic execution claimed.

transfer_to_repo: Do not reward the current quantifier/scope failures with LE; benchmark typed reference formulas instead.
code_status: README and evaluator source inspected; not executed

title: Divide and Translate: Compositional First-Order Logic Translation and Verification for Complex Logical Reasoning
representation: Many-sorted FOL with logical dependency structures
method: LLM first prepares an estimated theory and target NL sentence set from the whole problem; then decomposes into units, couplers and dependents; progressive translation; equivalence clusters; solver counter-interpretations judged against prepared NL by an LLM.
verification_guarantee: Solver checks formula equivalence and produces distinguishing interpretations.
not_guaranteed: NL judgment of a countermodel remains learned
Correct formula may not be in sampled candidates
Initial theory/signature may be wrong
Preprocessing fidelity and coverage: checking the prepared NL targets cannot restore an original qualifier lost in preprocessing.

evaluation.endpoint: Final answer accuracy, executability, conditional accuracy; annotated AR-LSAT formula analysis

transfer_to_repo: Directly relevant to nested connective/quantifier composition and discriminating group counterexamples; preserve source coverage outside the solver.

title: LOGIC-LM++: Multi-Step Refinement for Symbolic Formulations
method: Restore source problem/question to refinement; pairwise LLM semantic comparison and backtracking.
verification_guarantee: Existing solver checks remain; semantic edit acceptance is model-based.
not_guaranteed: Backtracking cannot certify source equivalence
Very wrong initial formulas and weaker semantic judges remain difficult
transfer_to_repo: Source-aware reversible repairs can be tested on polarity and overstatement; an accepted edit is still not a clinical certificate.
code_status: No official repository located in reviewed paper or targeted author/project searches; not proof that none exists

title: Autoformalizing Natural Language to First-Order Logic: A Case Study in Logical Fallacy Detection
primary_type: Findings IJCNLP-AACL peer-reviewed paper; earlier arXiv 2024
method: Entities, predicates, claims and conclusion; NLI-inferred background implications; validity checking and countermodel explanation.
verification_guarantee: SMT reasoning relative to compiled theory.
not_guaranteed: Inferred background implications are not explicit source rules
Fallacy classification is not exact formalization

evaluation.caveat: Table 2 uses datasets augmented with non-fallacious negative arguments derived from SNLI entailments; the direct comparator is few-shot end-to-end classification, not the unaugmented original LOGIC task.

transfer_to_repo: Keep inferred bridge assumptions separate from guideline provenance; countermodel explanations can expose unsupported diagnostic implications.
source_locations: Method pipeline and SMT construction; experimental setup/Table 2

title: FoVer: First-Order Logic Verification for Natural Language Reasoning
representation: Python functions using a custom Z3 FOL wrapper
method: Coarse-to-fine annotated reasoning, predicate/type definitions, delayed quantifier declaration, optional separate common-knowledge statements. Algorithm 1 removes definitions in an unsatisfiable core before verifying the retained theory; this changes the theory.
verification_guarantee: Z3 checks conclusions relative to the retained compiled theory, after any removal of conflicting auxiliary definitions.
not_guaranteed: Correct Python is not correct NL grounding
Optional background knowledge can introduce unsupported premises
Quantifier declaration conventions do not prove semantic scope
Unsat-core removal does not certify fidelity of the removed or retained definitions to the original text, or prove a maximum-faithfulness repair.

evaluation.caveat: Table 2 distinguishes single queried conclusion from all questions in a sample; paper does not establish a same-cached-formulas, scoring-only contrast, and execution rates differ. Relaxed scoring accepts True/False when the original label is Unknown. These are not source-fidelity metrics.
evaluation.FOLIO_prompt_condition: Table 3 specific prompt places entities in one Entity sort; universal prompt may infer different sorts.

transfer_to_repo: Typed program representation and separate background channel are useful; source-only and augmented conditions need separate reporting.
source_locations: §3.3 Algorithm 1: definition removal; §5.1/Table 2: strict versus relaxed; §5.2/Table 3: universal versus specific Entity-sort prompt

title: Advancing Natural Language Formalization to First Order Logic with Fine-tuned LLMs
method: Fine-tune on MALLS/Willow; compare free, supplied/noisy predicates and two-stage predicate prediction; optional predicate-name matching.
verification_guarantee: Proved unsatisfiability of negated biconditional establishes equivalence under encoded reference/signature.
not_guaranteed: Timeout is not inequivalence
Reference equivalence assumes correct reference and symbol grounding
Oracle predicate lists do not measure end-to-end extraction

evaluation.endpoint: Exact formula match and solver equivalence

transfer_to_repo: Separate predicate identity from composition; clinical metric/name matching cannot safely use generic edit-distance equivalence.
source_locations: Official repository README, currently describing later GROVES data
code_status: Repository inspected; current README/data description has evolved beyond paper snapshot

title: Are LLMs Stable Formal Logic Translators in Logical Reasoning Across Linguistically Diversified Texts?
representation: FOL with a maintained NL-concept/logical-symbol table
method: SoLT meaning-preserving linguistic diversification; MenTaL reuses/refines symbol mappings and compound expressions.
verification_guarantee: Benchmark checks outcomes and symbol drift; model manages semantic identity.
not_guaranteed: Low symbol dispersion does not rule out over-merging different concepts
Not all language rewrites have a formal source-fidelity proof
Benefits are model-dependent

evaluation.endpoint: Final accuracy and Symbol Dispersion Score
evaluation.caveat: SDS tracks one concept mapped to multiple symbols, not complete predicate/argument fidelity.

transfer_to_repo: Test synonym consistency together with subtype and marker anti-merging; case 56 parent routing and case 773 metric mismatch need both.
source_locations: Original official URL https://github.com/wufeiwuwoshihua/LinguDiver redirects to the recorded code_url
code_status: Repository redirect and README inspected; not executed

title: Robustness of Neurosymbolic Reasoners on First-Order Logic Problems
method: Counterfactual label-preserving problem rewrites; compare CoT, LINC, and CoT-before-formalization.
verification_guarantee: Tests robustness of complete pipelines; no new source-equivalence guarantee.
not_guaranteed: A smaller counterfactual drop does not imply higher accuracy
Unknown predictions can change apparent robustness

evaluation.endpoint: Final accuracy and counterfactual performance gap

transfer_to_repo: Require both absolute quality and perturbation stability; stable wrong/proxy answers must not count as faithful extraction.
